reviews.name: 홍밥풀
reviews.content:
이거 완전 코박장이네요 (코박고하는장난감ㅎ)

알배추가 밥풀이 머리통이랑 똑같이 생겼서요!!
알배추 전체가 바스락 거려서 가지고 놀기 딱 좋은데,
잎파리 부분을 고무밴드로 묶어주면 엄~청 쨍쨍해서 노즈워크 난이도가 올라가서 너무 좋아요!!

근데 밥씨는 노즈워크 달인이라 엄청 잘할 줄 알았는데 고무밴드로 묶으니까 한참 가지고 놀드라구요 ㅎㅎ
초보 강쥐들은 고무밴드 없이 잎파리 사이사이 숨겨도 충분히 오래 가지고 놀 수 있을 것 같아요!!

밥푸리 통수와 똑같은 알배추 장난감
후 메잌 토이!!💚💚
reviews.content_en:
This is totally a nose-burying toy! (a toy for nose-digging play lol)

Albaechu looks exactly like Bobpul's head!!
Since the whole Albaechu crinkles, it's perfect for playing with,
and when you tie the leafy parts with a rubber band, it makes such a satisfying crinkly sound that the nose work difficulty goes up—I love it!!

But Bobsshi is a nose work expert so I thought he'd be really good at it, but once I tied it with a rubber band, he spent a long time playing with it lol
For beginner dogs, I think they can play with it for a long time even without the rubber band, just hiding it between the leaves!!

Albaechu toy that looks exactly like Bobpul's head
Fur Make Toy!! 💚💚

reviews.name: 여름
reviews.content:
바스락, 삑삑이에 노즈워크가 가능한 작고 가볍지만 똑똑한 장난감이예요!

넓고 긴 배추 이파리가 전체가 바스락이고 소리도 커서 
처음 보자마자 흥미를 보이더라고요.
게다가 알배추의 얼굴 부분에는 삑삑이까지 있어서, 
한참을 시간 가는 줄 모르고 놀았어요!

그리고 간식좋아 강아지에게 제일 중요한 노즈워크...!
여름이는 노즈워크 장난감을 정말 좋아해서 하루에 한 번은 해 주는데,
알배추 장난감은 이파리 사이사이에 손쉽게 간식을 넣고 
고무줄로 조여 주면 (고무줄로 조이면 알배추가 정말 너무 귀여워요...) 
노즈워크 고수인 여름이도 꽤 오래 놀 수 있어서 편하고 유용해요!

제가 이 알배추를 작게 바스락거리기만 해도 자다 벌떡 일어나서 달려올만큼
사랑 받고 있는 장난감입니다!
reviews.content_en:
A small, lightweight but smart toy with crinkle, squeaky sounds and nose work capability!

The wide and long cabbage leaves crinkle all over and the sound is loud, so
he showed interest right away when he first saw it.
Plus, the face part of the Albaechu has a squeaker too,
so he played for ages without noticing the time passing!

And the most important thing for a treat-loving dog is nose work...!
Yeomi really loves nose work toys, so I do it once a day,
and with the Albaechu toy, I can easily hide treats between the leaves
and tighten with a rubber band (when you tighten it with the rubber band, the Albaechu looks so adorable...)
and even Yeomi, a nose work expert, can play with it for quite a while, so it's convenient and useful!

Just by making a small crinkly sound with this Albaechu, he jumps up from sleeping and runs over—
it's that beloved of a toy!

reviews.name: 류****
reviews.content:
#체험단🤩
1일1노즈워크견인 우리 아이한테 딱 맞는 싱싱 알배추!!
솔직히 중대형견에겐 작지않나 싶었었는데 아닙니다ㅋㅋㅋ
아주 첫날부터 양배추에 코박고 노즈워크 삼매경에 불러도 모르쇠..더라구요🤣
바스락거리는 잎들에 얼굴그림쪽엔 삑삑이까지 있어서 더욱더 신나게 흥을 돋궈주기도😝
밴드가 난이도 조절이 되니 매일 조금씩 다르게 설정해서 줄수 있고 은근 간식들이 쏙쏙 많이 들어가서 최고에요!!
아직까지 튼튼하게 버텨주어 만족스럽네요😁
reviews.content_en:
#Review Team 🤩
Perfect crispy Albaechu for our pup who does 1 nose work session daily!!
Honestly I was worried it might be too small for a large breed dog, but it's not lol
From the very first day, he buried his nose in the cabbage and got so absorbed in nose work that he wouldn't respond even when called 🤣
The crinkly leaves plus the squeaker on the face part make him even more excited 😝
The band allows difficulty adjustment, so I can set it a bit differently each day, and it's amazing how many treats fit inside!
It's held up strong so far, so I'm very satisfied 😁

reviews.name: 신****
reviews.content:
상추처럼 노즈워크를 사랑하는 아이들한테 딱 맞는 장난감이에요
알배추 모양이라 잎 사이사이에 간식 숨기기 좋아서 자연스럽게 노즈워크가 되더라구요.
특히 고무밴드로 난이도 조절이 가능해서 처음엔 쉽게, 익숙해지면 더 어렵게 활용 가능해요.
잎 부분은 바스락 소리가 나서 흥미를 계속 끌어주고, 얼굴에는 삑삑이까지 있어서 지루할 틈이 없어요.
상추도 간식 찾으면서 집중력 확 올라가고 혼자서도 한참 잘 놀더라구요.
단순 장난감이 아니라 놀이+두뇌활동까지 같이 되는 느낌!
노즈워크 입문용부터 심화용까지 다 가능한 다기능 장난감으로 추천해요
reviews.content_en:
It's the perfect toy for dogs who love nose work like Sangchu
Because it's shaped like Albaechu, it's easy to hide treats between the leaves, so nose work happens naturally.
Especially since you can adjust the difficulty with the rubber band—easy at first, and more challenging as they get the hang of it.
The leaf part makes a crinkly sound to keep their interest, and there's a squeaker on the face so there's no room for boredom.
Sangchu gets really focused when searching for treats and can play alone for quite a while.
It's not just a simple toy—it's play plus brain activity combined!
I recommend it as a multi-functional toy that works for everything from nose work beginners to advanced users

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
#체험단#바잇미체험닷#노즈워크장난감
싱싱한 배추 배송받았어요🥬
일하는엄마라 출근하면서 노즈워크 장난감을 몇개씩 해주고 출근하는 편이거든요
워낙 간식을 좋아해서 금방 잘찾아먹는데 끈으로 난이도조절할수있어서 더 오래 먹을수있어요
간식없을땐 그냥 삑삑이도 연주하고 바스락바스락 재밌게 갖고노네요
집에놀러온 친구도 너무 좋아해서 인기만점이었습니다
원단도 부들부들해서 피부자극도 없을거같아요
두손써가면서 간식 먹는모습 너무 귀여워서 자꾸 해주고싶네요
reviews.content_en:
#Review Team #BITE ME Review Dot #Nose Work Toy
Got a fresh cabbage delivered 🥬
Since I'm a working mom, I usually do a few nose work toys before heading to work.
My pup loves treats and finds them quickly, but with the string difficulty adjustment, she can enjoy it longer
When there are no treats, she just squeaks the squeaker and crinkles it around having fun
A friend who visited home loved it too—it was super popular
The fabric is soft so it shouldn't irritate her skin
The way she uses both paws to eat the treats is so cute, so I find myself wanting to do this more often

reviews.name: 한****
reviews.content:
#체험단#바잇미체험단
노즈워크 달인인 우리 강아지!(아니 힘즈워크ㅋㅋ 뿌셔뿌셔)
고무줄로 묶어 난이도UP 가능한게 증말 신의 한 수!
힘즈워크하는 강아지가 빼먹는데 5분, 빼먹고 나서도 한참을 가지고 놀아서 여유가 생겼어요🥹
집에 놓고 출근할 때 노즈워크를 굉장히 많이 뿌리고 가는데, 그때도 활용이 좋아요!!👍(엄마 없다고 문앞에 누워 심심해 하지 않고 오래도록 즐겁게 놀았음 하쟈나용)
김장김치 배추 속 무치듯이, 한주먹 사료 쥐고 배춧잎 한장한장 넘겨가며 사료넣는 재미도 있는 장난감 입니다ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
"노즈워크 장난감 사려는데 고민된다!" 한다면 배추부터 PICK 하시길😆
추천추천 왕추천!
reviews.content_en:
#Review Team #BITE ME Review Team
Our dog is a nose work expert! (or should I say force work lol, push push)
Being able to increase difficulty with a rubber band is truly a divine move!
It takes my pup 5 minutes to get the treats out, and then she plays with it for a long time after, so it gives me a breather 🥹
I often leave lots of nose work toys at home when I go to work, and this is great for that too!! 👍 (hoping she'll play happily for a long time instead of lying by the door bored without mom)
It's a toy where you can have fun stuffing kibble into the cabbage leaves one by one, like preparing kimchi—just grab a handful of food and flip through each leaf lol
If you're thinking "I want to get a nose work toy but can't decide!" then definitely PICK the cabbage first 😆
Highly recommend, super highly recommend!

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
예~얍!! 싱싱한 배추가 왔어요!! 
우리 몽이는요 사실 인형 삑삑이 바스락 장난감도 많지만 
관심도 없고요 ㅠㅠ 
노즈워크는 멍때리는 친구라 잘 못해요 하하핰 ㅋㅋ
오로지 라텍스 동글동글 공입니다:) 
잘 때도 끌어안고 자고 하루에도 몇백번을 던져야 하죠!
그때 마침 싱싱한 배추가 배달이 왔어요! 유후~ 
신상이라 좋아하는가 싶어 지켜봤는데 
몽이는 야채도 알배추를 제일 좋아해서 그런지 
가지고 노는 시간이 꽤 길었습니다. 보호자 시점ㅋㅋ
노즈워크용 간식으로 배추에 소금쳐서 절여줬더니
아주 흰자를 보이며 애미도 못알아보고 으르렁되며 먹어요 ㅠ 
이제 다양하게 놀잇감을 이용해서 
놀아줘야겠다고 많이 반성했네요. 
바잇미 감사합니다🩵
reviews.content_en:
Yay~! Fresh cabbage arrived!!
Our Mongi actually has lots of plush squeaky and crinkly toys
but she's not interested in them 😭
She's not good at nose work either lol 😂
She only loves rubber latex balls 🙂
She cuddles with it while sleeping and I have to throw it hundreds of times a day!
So when the fresh cabbage arrived, it was perfect timing!
Since it's new, I wondered if she'd like it, and
because Mongi loves Albaechu vegetables especially, she
played with it for quite a while. From the owner's perspective lol
When I gave her the cabbage with treats salted like kimchi preparation,
she ate it with her eyes wide showing the whites, growling like I couldn't even recognize her 😢
Now I realized I need to play with her using a variety of toys in different ways.
Thank you BITE ME 🩵
